arxiv-1702-06449.title: POVMs are equivalent to projections for perfect state exclusion of three pure states in three dimensions
arxiv-1702-06449.creator: Abel Molina
arxiv-1702-06449.description: A 2017 arXiv research paper by Abel Molina. Performing perfect/conclusive quantum state exclusion means to be able to discard with certainty at least one out of n n possible quantum state preparations by performing a measurement of the resulting state. This task of state exclusion has recently been studied at length in [ 5 ] , and it is at the heart of the celebrated PBR thought experiment [ 31 ] .

arxiv-2206-13793.title: Real-time nanoparticle characterization through opto-fluidic force induction
arxiv-2206-13793.creator: Marko Šimić, Doris Auer, Christian Neuper, Nikola Šimić, Gerhard Prossliner, Ruth Prassl, Christian Hill, Ulrich Hohenester
arxiv-2206-13793.description: Abstract We propose and demonstrate a novel scheme for optical nanoparticle characterization, optofluidic force induction (OF2i), which achieves real-time optical counting with single-particle sensitivity, high throughput, and for particle sizes ranging from tens of nanometers to several μ \mu m.

arxiv-2406-01833.title: CAFO: Feature-Centric Explanation on Time Series Classification
arxiv-2406-01833.creator: Jaeho Kim, Seok-Ju Hahn, Yoontae Hwang, Junghye Lee, Seulki Lee †
arxiv-2406-01833.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jaeho Kim, Seok-Ju Hahn, Yoontae Hwang, Junghye Lee, Seulki Lee †. In multivariate time series (MTS) classification, finding the important features (e.g., sensors) for model performance is crucial yet challenging due to the complex, high-dimensional nature of MTS data, intricate temporal dynamics, and the necessity for domain-specific interpretations. Current explanation methods for MTS mostly focus on time-centric explanations, apt for pinpointing important time periods but less effective in identifying key features.

arxiv-2410-14795.title: Cross-Document Event-Keyed Summarization
arxiv-2410-14795.creator: William Walden, Pavlo Kuchmiichuk, Alexander Martin, Chihsheng Jin, Angela Cao, Claire Sun, Curisia Allen, Aaron Steven White
arxiv-2410-14795.description: Abstract Event-keyed summarization (EKS) requires summarizing a specific event described in a document given the document text and an event representation extracted from it. In this work, we extend EKS to the cross-document setting (CDEKS), in which summaries must synthesize information from accounts of the same event as given by multiple sources.

arxiv-2510-11443.title: Properties of generalized Jacobi elliptic functions with three parameters Thanks: The work of S. Takeuchi was supported by JSPS KAKENHI Grant Number 22K03392.
arxiv-2510-11443.creator: Hajime Sato, Nagi Suzuki, Shingo Takeuchi
arxiv-2510-11443.description: Abstract . Jacobi elliptic functions and complete elliptic integrals are generalized using three parameters. These generalized functions and integrals are closely related to ordinary differential equations involving p p -Laplacian. In this paper, Wallis-type integral formulae are constructed for the generalized Jacobi elliptic functions.

arxiv-2511-09609.title: TempRetinex: Retinex-based Unsupervised Enhancement for Low-light Video Under Diverse Lighting Conditions
arxiv-2511-09609.creator: Yini Li, Nantheera Anantrasirichai
arxiv-2511-09609.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yini Li, Nantheera Anantrasirichai. Videos inherently contain rich temporal information that provides complementary cues for low-light enhancement beyond what can be achieved with single images. We propose TempRetinex, a novel unsupervised Retinex-based framework that effectively exploits inter-frame correlations for video enhancement. To address the poor generalization of existing unsupervised methods under varying illumination, we introduce adaptive brightness adjustment (ABA) preprocessing that explicitly aligns lighting distributions across exposures.

pmc-11311311.creator: Yung-Lung Chen, Hui-Ting Wang, Wen-Chin Lee, Pei-Ting Lin, Wen-Hao Liu, Shu-Kai Hsueh, Andrea D′Amato
pmc-11311311.description: A previous study showed that high-glucose (HG) conditions induce mitochondria fragmentation through the calcium-mediated activation of extracellular signal-regulated kinase 1/2 (ERK 1/2) in H9C2 cells. This study tested whether empagliflozin could prevent HG-induced mitochondria fragmentation through this pathway. We found that exposing H9C2 cells to an HG concentration decreased cell viability and increased cell apoptosis and caspase-3.

pmc-12404809.creator: Rishab Rajan Pillai, Jendrian Riedel, Wytamma Wirth, Slade Allen-Ankins, Eric Nordberg, Will Edwards, Lin Schwarzkopf

uslaw-usc-t14-s711.title: 14 U.S.C. § 711 — Coast Guard officers as attachés to missions
uslaw-usc-t14-s711.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t14-s711.description: United States Code, Title 14 (Coast Guard); Chapter 7 (Cooperation). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Commissioned officers may, with the consent of the Secretary of State, be regularly and officially attached to the diplomatic missions of the United States in those nations with which the United States is extensively engaged in maritime commerce. Expenses for the maintenance of such Coast Guard attachés.
